source_refs.summary: [P2] Preserve document permissions independently of umask

witness_subject.schema_or_environment: Agent4 frozen candidate on unchanged Boundary2/World5; Node26.8.2
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: When the existing document permits access masked by the process umask, creating the temporary file with its mode does not preserve those permissions: `open` applies the umask again. For example, a `0660` document becomes `0600` under umask `0077` after a successful replacement, preventing other group-based readers and writers from accessing it. Restore the intended mode on the temporary file before syncing and renaming it.

record.observed_fact: runtime/document.mjs passes original mode only to open(O_CREAT), which intersects it with process umask, then renames that reduced-mode file without restoring its mode.
record.independence_basis: Distinct obligation and source path; duplicates retain provenance in this record.

witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: For an interaction carrying the 5,000-node recursive list supported by `test/agent4/values.test.mjs`, this recursive rendering throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`. witness_subject.artifact_state_label: PR27 automated review on published successor
witness_subject.schema_or_environment: Agent4 frozen candidate on unchanged Boundary2/World5; Node26.8.2
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject documents that exceed the result schema**

When `document.txt` contains more than the packaged application's 128-byte `Text128` limit, this unbounded `readFile()` still returns `kind: "success"`; `readReply` in `test/agent4/document_runtime.mjs` then tries to encode that content into the request's bounded resume schema and throws `ValueCodecError` instead of returning the declared document-read failure. Thus even a modest real document can abort the interaction outside its authored failure path, while a very large file can also force an unbounded allocation. The environment should enforce a configured/schema-aligned byte limit before returning success.

record.observed_fact: readCurrent uses unbounded handle.readFile and returns any UTF-8 content as success; document_runtime encodes it into bounded_text128 outside that operation, so 129-byte files throw codec errors instead of authored read failure.

witness_subject.input_state_or_trace:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep display decoding from failing successful runner commands**

When a valid interaction request contains more than the value codec's default one-million-node materialization budget—for example, a large sequence in its outgoing value—this `decodeValue` call throws `ValueCapacity`. `executeCli` writes the authoritative checkpoint before calling `inspectPending`, so the operation is durably saved but the CLI subsequently exits with an error solely because its non-authoritative display could not be materialized; callers may treat the transition as failed and retry its prior input. Inspection should fall back to the generic `typed_request` view when optional interaction decoding exceeds host display capacity.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

record.observed_fact: inspectPending always materializes known interaction payload through the codec default maxNodes1000000; ValueCapacity propagates instead of returning the existing generic typed_request view.
